items.name: LocalScript
items.source:
local rep = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local model3d = require(rep.Packages.Module3D)
local meow = "Los Mr Carrotitos"
local find = rep:WaitForChild("Assets"):WaitForChild("Enemies"):FindFirstChild(meow)

if meow then
	model3d:Attach3D(script.Parent, find)
end

items.name: LocalScript
items.source:
local GPI = require(game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Packages"):WaitForChild("GPI"))
local mrkt = game:GetService("MarketplaceService")
local plr = game.Players.LocalPlayer

script.Parent.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	local id = GPI.getProductIdByName("5K Money")
	if id then
		mrkt:PromptProductPurchase(plr, id)
	end
end)
